note: City of Breckenridge park and Wilkin County fairgrounds at the Bois de Sioux / Otter Tail confluence, with sites scattered among the fair buildings (1-8) and a row of three by the park shop on the east side (9-11). Disc golf and a playground. --Claude
summary: City park page + Wix booking read: 11 sites (8 W/E at $35, 3 with sewer; 3 rustic at $25), 50/30/15 A, flush toilets, outdoor shower, dump; book online or by phone; currently 'CLOSED for the Season' (no dates). Riverview NOT supported: the site photos show no water - downgrade candidate. Google 4.4/77.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE CANDIDATE (stored riverview -> not waterfront): the city's map puts sites 9-11 (about 46.26536,-96.59447 to 46.26525,-96.59407) by the park shop on the east side, roughly 40-80 m from the Otter Tail River behind a row of spruce and a brushy raised bank; sites 6-8 (north, by the stables) face a dense treeline on the city's own photos; sites 1-5 sit among the fair buildings away from both rivers. None of the eleven city site photos shows water. No site meets the view rule on this evidence.

Fairgrounds check: the park is the Wilkin County Fair grounds ('Welles Memorial Park & Fairgrounds' on the city map), and the city rents ordinary nights online per site, so it passes the fairground test.

Rig fit: site 6 'up to 25 ft', site 8 and (booking page) 4-5 'small camper'; 9-11 'Camper 30'+'. A 23-ft rig fits several sites. No pull-through stated; max_rig_ft not written (the '30'+' sites have no stated limit).
Season: the park page says 'Campsite Reservations: CLOSED for the Season' with no opening or closing dates; no season written.
Phone 218-643-1431 confirmed (city page, rules page and Google Maps). Websites confirmed (both 200).
Pin 46.26464,-96.59485 is on the park road near the Nebraska Ave entrance bridge, within about 150-250 m of every site group: fine.
Note cleaned: dropped the hookups, amps, restrooms, showers and 'Reservable online' (fields hold them) and the 'New campsites' wording.
